text: places picture   Scene 8  Sibyl’s Dressing Room
speaker: C1

text: As soon as the play was over, Dorian rushed behind the scenes into the green room.
speaker: C2

text: The girl was standing there alone,
speaker: SIBYL

text: amongst the costumes and the lights and the greasepaint.
speaker: C3

text: She had a look of triumph on her face.
speaker: C4

text: Her eyes were lit with an exquisite fire. There was a radiance about her. Her parted lips were smiling over some secret of their own.
speaker: C1

text: How badly I acted to-night, my love!
speaker: SIBYL

text: Horribly! It was dreadful. Are you ill? You have no idea what I suffered.
speaker: Dorian

text: You should have understood what I was doing. But you do understand now, don't you?
speaker: SIBYL

text: Why I was so bad to-night. Why I shall always be bad. Why I shall never act well again.
speaker: SIBYL

text: You are ill, I suppose. When you are ill you shouldn't act. You make yourself ridiculous. My friends were bored. I was bored.
speaker: Dorian

text: Before I knew you, acting was the one reality of my life. I thought that it was all true. I believed everything. I knew nothing but shadows, and I thought them real. You came and you freed my soul from prison. You taught me what reality really is. To-night, for the first time in my life, I saw through the hollowness, the sham, the silliness of the empty pageant in which I had always played. To-night, for the first time, I saw that the words I had to speak were unreal, were not my words, were not what I wanted to say. You had brought me something higher. You had made me understand what love really is. I have grown sick of shadows. You are more to me than all art can ever be. I heard them hissing, and I smiled. What could they know of love such as ours? Take me away, with you, where we can be quite alone. I hate the stage. I might mimic a passion that I do not feel, but I cannot mimic one that burns me like fire. Even if I could do it, it would be profanation for me to play at being in love.
speaker: SIBYL

text: You have killed my love (she laughs and goes to him he pushes her away and goes to the door) You used to stir my imagination. Now you don't even stir my curiosity. I loved you because you were marvellous, because you had genius and intellect, because you realised the dreams of great poets and gave shape and substance to the shadows of art. You have thrown it all away. You are shallow and stupid. I wish I had never laid eyes upon you! You have spoiled the romance of my life. Without your art, you are nothing. I would have made you famous, splendid, magnificent. What are you now? A third-rate actress with a pretty face.
speaker: Dorian

text: You are not serious, Dorian? You are acting.
speaker: SIBYL

text: Please don't leave me! I am so sorry I didn't act well. I was thinking of you all the time. But I will try. Don’t go away from me. I couldn't bear it. After all, it is only once that I have not pleased you. I should have shown myself more of an artist. It was foolish of me, and yet I couldn't help it.
speaker: SIBYL

text: I am going. I don't wish to be unkind, but I can't see you again. You have disappointed me.
speaker: Dorian
